title: Going Back to Study
sentences: After eleven years at work, I decided to go back to college.
I had thought about it for a long time before I applied.
The hardest part was admitting that I had forgotten how to study.
In the first month I read everything twice and still felt lost.
Most of the other students were about ten years younger than me.
They were quicker with the reading, but I asked better questions.
My tutor told me that experience counts for more than speed.
I now study for two hours every evening, even when I am tired.
My marks are not brilliant, but they have improved each term.
If I finish next year, I will be the first in my family to do so.
